newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar barely down, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar barely down, trade thin.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures had barely budged in dull midsession trade, with many players expected to remain absent from the ring during New York's annual Sugar Week, floor sources said.
"It's Sugar Week and that says it all," a dealer said. "This is the most quiet week of the year."
An estimated 3,455 lots changed hands as of 1100 EDT.
At 1130 EDT, the July contract stood 0.01 cent lower at 10.96 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.01 to 10.94 cents. The outer contracts were unchanged to 0.02 cent lower.
Technically, traders expect the July contract to find nearby support at 10.92 cents followed by 10.85 cents.
Resistance was cited at the recent high of 11.11 cents followed by 11.20 cents.
"Fall back on old technicals and fundamentals because there is nothing new here," the trader said.
